_readme: Every achievement in the game. Edit this file, then run Prince's Palace > Build Default Content. THIS FILE IS THE ONLY SOURCE OF TRUTH for what achievements exist — relics.json's unlockedBy is validated against the ids here at content-build time, so a relic can never be gated on an achievement that does not exist. Achievement ids end up in save data the moment one is earned, so NEVER RENAME ONE after a save exists: the player loses whatever it gated. Field-by-field documentation, defaults and valid enum values: docs/CONTENT_SCHEMA.md.

achievements.description: Put down the thing that guards the first forest.
Reach step forty of a single descent.
Deal a million damage across every run.
